page_title: FUL 0-2 CHE | Fulham v Chelsea 02/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Willian (Fulham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+6' Moises Caicedo just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) replaces him.
90+5' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Alex Matos (Chelsea) replaces Enzo Fernandez.
90+5' Willian (Fulham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+5' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+2' Tom Cairney (Fulham) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick. Chelsea will take a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts to feed Carlos Vinicius with a chip pass, but Robert Sanchez reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
87' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
87' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
85' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
84' The game is interrupted now, Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Carlos Vinicius (Fulham), but the defence gets it clear.
80' The attendance for today's match is 24445.
78' Fulham win a corner.
78' It will be a substitution. Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea) is ready to enter the pitch as Cole Palmer walks off.
78' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
77' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Willian darts into free space to control the ball.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Pereira leaves the pitch and Sasa Lukic (Fulham) comes on.
74' Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) rises high to meet a cross and steers his header low to the right post. The goalkeeper makes an amazing save.
74' Robert Sanchez comes off his line to intercept the corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham).

73' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
71' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
70' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
68' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) receives a yellow card.
66' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
65' Here comes a substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Harrison Reed.
65' Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) takes the corner.
65' Mauricio Pochettino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Armando Broja suffers an injury and Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) comes on.

63' Bernd Leno makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) meets a cross from Harrison Reed, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
61' Willian (Fulham) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Alex Iwobi with a fine lofted pass.
60' The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.

56' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the right side of the goal, but it lacks power and Robert Sanchez pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
55' The booking goes to Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
54' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Harry Wilson will be replaced by Alex Iwobi (Fulham).
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) is coming onto the pitch as Raul Jimenez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
52' Tim Robinson blows his whistle as Timothy Castagne (Fulham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Chelsea get a free kick.
50' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends a long ball in, but Bernd Leno comfortably gathers the ball.

49' Armando Broja (Chelsea) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Cole Palmer, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
48' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Armando Broja, who is lurking close to the offside line.
47' Harry Wilson (Fulham) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
46' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) sends an accurate short pass. Axel Disasi controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) will not participate anymore and Ian Maatsen is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Armando Broja (Chelsea) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45' Armando Broja (Chelsea) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.

42' Andreas Pereira floats the corner into the six-yard box, but the ball spins off the head of Raul Jimenez (Fulham) and falls to safety well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
42' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
40' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
38' Armando Broja (Chelsea) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
37' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) sends a long ball forward to Mykhailo Mudryk, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. It's a throw-in for Fulham.
36' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
34' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
32' It could have been a good chance to score! Levi Colwill (Chelsea) fails to release Armando Broja with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
30' Armando Broja (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Fulham.

30' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
28' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) sends a long ball forward to Andreas Pereira, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a throw-in.

27' Wonderful pass from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) for Armando Broja, but they can't profit from it as Bernd Leno comes off his line to collect. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
25' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.
25' A raking crossfield pass from Timothy Castagne (Fulham) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick.
23' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Levi Colwill (Chelsea) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fulham.

19' 0 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Armando Broja (Chelsea) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:2.

18' 0 - 1 Levi Colwill sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.
17' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

17' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The ball is behind the touchline and Fulham will take a throw-in.
15' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
13' Armando Broja (Chelsea) couldn't beat the offside trap and the flag goes up. The assistant referee quickly made a difficult call as it was a really tight offside.
12' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) picks out Mykhailo Mudryk with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.

10' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) receives a reproachful look from Enzo Fernandez. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
10' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
9' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
8' Issa Diop (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Tim Robinson signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to Chelsea.
7' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fulham.
4' Willian receives a sweet cross inside the box from Harry Wilson (Fulham), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
4' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) jumps into a tackle and Tim Robinson signals a foul. Fulham earn a free kick.
3' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Enzo Fernandez collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.

2' Armando Broja (Chelsea) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
2' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.

Fulham will kick the game off.
